use_case: Workforce assistant: generative answers to managers' and workers' questions, schedule drafts, and summaries of HR case notes inside Workforce Cloud
vendor_or_model: Third-party hosted large language model (zero-retention terms) with in-house retrieval and filters
data_categories: Schedules, time, policies, HR case notes (customer worker data); Social Security and bank numbers filtered out
consequential_decision_category: None directly; re-tier to Employment if summaries are used to rank or discipline workers
human_in_the_loop: Managers review and act; drafts are never applied without a person; summaries labeled as AI-generated
applicable_laws: FTC Act Sec. 5 (N51-R01: AI and privacy claims); customer DPAs and sub-processor terms; CCPA service-provider terms (N51-R03)
status: In production for 6,200 opt-in customers; continue with conditions

use_case: Attrition-risk insights: predictive scores that flag workers likely to leave, shown to customer managers and HR
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted model trained on aggregated, de-identified customer data
data_categories: Tenure, schedule patterns, absences, pay changes, manager changes (customer worker data)
human_in_the_loop: Customers decide what to do; product guidance says scores must not be the sole basis for any employment decision
applicable_laws: Colo. SB26-189 (developer duties from 2027-01-01); customers' CCPA ADMT duties (N51-R03; compliance by 2027-01-01); Title VII and ADEA exposure for customers; FTC Act Sec. 5 (N51-R01: "bias-tested and fair" claim withdrawn)
status: In production for about 9,800 customers; new enablement paused

data_categories: Availability, skills, labor rules, demand forecasts

use_case: Merchant risk scoring: onboarding risk and transaction fraud scores for merchants
